<div class="card-body">
'''Red 3''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レッド3</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名、操縦ドロイド1名を追加してよい。戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使うためには、パイロットが乗っていなければならない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-145o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いにおけるビッグズ・ダークライターの戦闘機。サラスト近辺のエクリプティック・イヴェイダーズ飛行中隊の一機だったが、ヤヴィン基地に転属となった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Red 3.

'''Card text:''' May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed.

'''Lore:''' Biggs Darklighter's fighter at the Battle of Yavin. Once with the Ecliptic Evaders near Sullust, later transferred to Yavin base.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Red 3]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
